name: G. W. Racek
role: Bismarck saddler opening a harness shop in Medora
mentions: G. W. Racek, the well-known saddler and harness maker of Bismarck, came in last evening. His intention is to start a harness shop here and he will make a specialty of cow boy outfit…

We have received a letter from G. W. Racek, of Bismarck, containing substantial proof of his belief in Medora's future. In other words he has bought a business lot and will soon open a large harness and saddlery…
